name: Rater8 Testimonials Block
description: Showcase Rater8 customer testimonials in a block.
project_description:
The Rater8 Testimonial Block is a customizable widget designed to display customer feedback and testimonials directly on your Drupal website. 

 It integrates seamlessly with the Rater8 platform, enabling you to showcase positive reviews and ratings from satisfied clients. By featuring genuine testimonials, you can establish trust with potential customers and improve your online reputation. 

 Note: This block requires Rater8 ID to display testimonials.
